handoffs.message: Audit complete. Full findings at audits/oss-alignment/claude_audit.md. Summary: (1) EX-001 must be reset to in_progress/blocked — artifact-loader/ does not exist despite done status. (2) P3-001 valid design but needs LEAN integration bridge: pin LEAN dep, fix _resolve_symbol() to use Symbol.Create(), add smoke test. (3) P4-001 valid; persona agent is local stub — upstream OpenClaw integration decision must be formally documented. (4) OC-001 and OC-003 valid as local contracts; upstream adapter work blocked on OpenClaw source selection. Recommended follow-up: 6 new tasks or corrections listed in §Required Follow-up.
